evidence_sentence: If the exception severity is undefined and the image is null, it destroys the exception info and potentially throws a warning.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation always calls throwExceptionExplicit after destroying exception information when severity is UndefinedException and image is null. The fixed implementation adds a !quiet() guard, making the warning conditional. Describing the warning as only potentially thrown reflects the fixed-only behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The function first checks if the provided image pointer is valid and if it has a subsequent frame. If so, it destroys any additional frames to ensure only one frame is retained. It then replaces the current image with the new one. If the exception severity is undefined and the image is null, it destroys the exception info and handles the no-image condition. If the image is not null, it throws an exception based on the image's exception information.
